evidence.quote: Microstructure and transformation behavior of Ni54Mn25Ga15Al6 high-temperature shape memory alloy

The purpose of this work is to investigate the microstructure, transformation behavior, mechanical properties and shape memory effect of Ni54Mn25Ga15Al6 alloy to show the effect of Al addition on the properties of Ni/g237Mn/g237Ga alloys.

The polycrystalline button ingots with the nominal composition of Ni54Mn25Ga15Al6 and Ni54Mn25Ga21 alloy were prepared with high-purity Ni (99.9%), Mn (99.9%), Ga (99.99%) and Al (99.99%) by melting 4 times in an arc-melting furnace under argon atmosphere.
